decisions.label: Official, plus well-known unofficial ones
decisions.question: Which songs and moments should get a YouTube clip?

autonomy.chose: A mistyped address lands on the 404 page, which sends you on to search with the address's last part as the words (`/album/blonde-on-blond/` → search "blonde on blond")
From 768 px the tab bar sits at the top of the screen
Each photo names its era and kind (`dylan` or `place`) in `photos.json`, and the panel picks a Dylan photo first; `eras.json`'s `photos` lists stay empty

autonomy.own: can you explore more why we didnt fully fill the connections here?
autonomy.chose: 49 connections, each one a fact the writers were sure of

autonomy.own: its fine if this is the only possibility but arfe you sure we dcant just quote some small parts? i dont undersand why we wouldnt be able to, this is common to cite a line from a song, even in popular culture
autonomy.chose: Every song's `excerpt` is empty: the field, its two-line limit, its credit and its place on the song page are built, but no lyric lines are written

autonomy.own: i think the fonts and styling can be much better, more individualistic; it's kind of boring and stock right now. each era should mean something and visually be represented by that via the page. it shouldnt be standardized, it should evoke the creativity of bob dylan
autonomy.chose: Each era's theme uses fonts already on the phone (system serif, condensed and typewriter stacks)
"Lyrics on bobdylan.com ↗" opens in a new tab
Song pages step to the album's previous and next song

autonomy.own: is this missing some songs do you mean?
autonomy.chose: The album page lists the dataset's songs, headed "Selected songs · 7 of 14" when they are fewer than the album's tracks
The threads are built by `tools/make-threads.mjs`: one per theme plus "Borrowed tunes" and "Songs others made famous", each card's sentence the song's note or the connection's why
Search forgives a typo or two (one edit at 4–5 letters, two from 6; a swapped pair counts as one) and takes `theme:<name>`, which the theme chips on song pages use

autonomy.own: we should be able to view other videos here too i mean there should be a lot we can view and probably on more than two
autonomy.chose: Two YouTube clips, both posted by Bob Dylan's official channel: "Subterranean Homesick Blues" (the Dont Look Back cue-card film) and the "Things Have Changed" video on the 2001 Oscar moment

autonomy.own: for the 4 that werent found we must find a replacement for it; can't leave dry
autonomy.chose: Spotify track ids come from MusicBrainz's Spotify album links and Spotify's own album pages, kept only when Spotify's title for the track matches the song (177 of 181 album songs)
The site's base path is `/` (it lives at a domain's root)
The parts of the dataset are written as `data/parts/*.json` and merged by `tools/merge-data.mjs` into the seven files
Each era page (`/era/<id>/`) is the whole timeline, opened at that era
The map's layout is d3-force, run in the browser
The phone check drives the Chrome already on the machine (`CHROME_PATH`, else the HyperFrames cache)
The phone check does not size-check links inside running text or the map's dots, and answers outside requests (covers, players) with an empty reply, so it sees the drawn covers
